cohort: The study included 380,520 singleton births from a statewide population-based cohort.
finding: An interpregnancy interval of 1-2 years is associated with optimal fetal growth in both black and white women, with deviations from this range generally linked to increased risk of SGA and varying effects on LGA outcomes.
birth_weight: The study assessed outcomes related to birth weight percentiles (SGA and LGA).
gest_age: The study assessed outcomes related to gestational age (SGA and LGA).
